What We Coat for Hamilton Businesses

We coat steel and aluminum parts for Hamilton businesses, from small brackets to heavy welded frames. Every part is cleaned, pretreated, sprayed with thermoset powder and cured, so the finish resists chips, corrosion and everyday wear.

Typical powder coating Hamilton orders include steel fabrication weldments, conveyor frames, machine guards, railings, enclosures, trailer parts and shelving. Electrostatic spray wraps powder around edges and corners, and chemical pretreatment prepares the surface so the coating bonds and corrosion resistance lasts. The result is a chip-resistant finish that keeps its look in service.

Our curing oven supports parts up to 6,000 lb, so a large part and a batch of small brackets can share one order. Each metal needs different prep, so we confirm the powder and colour with you before spraying. A recorded colour code lets a later batch match the first.

Whether parts are new or already in service, powder coating in Hamilton follows the same process here. We inspect parts on arrival, mask threads and contact points, and describe the finish before work starts. Each batch is checked for an even, complete finish before it leaves, which is how Hamilton powder coating orders avoid surprises.

Services Available to Hamilton Customers

Hamilton customers can book sandblasting, surface preparation, custom colours, restoration and bulk production runs. Three services cover most requests: [industrial powder coating](/services/industrial-powder-coating) for frames and equipment, [sandblasting services](/services/sandblasting) for rust and mill scale, and [custom powder coating colours](/services/custom-colors-finishes) for matched or branded finishes.

Mobile sandblasting is available when a part is hard to move. Abrasive blasting strips rust and old coatings before pretreatment, and a RAL colour match, gloss, matte or textured finish can follow. Bulk orders and one-off parts are quoted by part type, size and quantity, and Hamilton powder coating jobs of either kind get the same careful prep.

Stripping and recoating can be combined with coating in one visit, so powder coating in Hamilton jobs go from rust removal to final cure under one roof. Our certification through the Absolute Bureau of Certification supports consistent quality, and test reports are available on request. Powder Coating Hamilton FAQs

Short answer: orders go smoothly when delivery, timing and finish are agreed before parts arrive. These answers cover pickup, timing, written quotes, rust removal, repeat colours and visiting hours for Hamilton customers.

blocks.q: Do you offer pickup and delivery for powder coating in Hamilton?
blocks.a: Yes, we offer both. Tell us your address, part sizes and quantity when you request a quote, and we will confirm what suits your order. You can also drop parts at our Milton shop during opening hours.

blocks.q: How long does Hamilton powder coating take?
blocks.a: We work to a 48 hour turnaround. Heavy rust removal, large parts or high volume can add time, so we confirm the schedule when you send details. Tell us your install date and we will plan back from it.

blocks.q: What should I send to get a quote for powder coating Hamilton orders?
blocks.a: Send photos, size, metal type, quantity and the colour or RAL code you want, and mention any threads or surfaces that must stay bare. We reply with the prep method, powder and timing, so you can compare the quote against your purchase order.

blocks.q: Can you remove rust and old coating first?
blocks.a: Yes. Abrasive blasting removes rust, mill scale and old coatings, and pretreatment follows before powder is applied. Mobile sandblasting is available when a part is hard to move. Tell us the condition of the parts and we will plan the prep.

blocks.q: Can I reorder the same colour later?
blocks.a: Yes. We record the colour code for each job, so a repeat order can match the original. Hamilton powder coating reorders go smoother when you quote the earlier job and its code.

blocks.q: When can I visit the shop with parts?
blocks.a: We are open Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM at 10874 Steeles Ave E, Milton, ON L9T 2X8. Call (905) 876-7060 first so we can confirm timing for your powder coating Hamilton order.
